text:
Maria (CS): Quick sync — Brightline dedicated pool onboarding. Need alignment on quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load-test window this week.
Sam O.: Okey. What's the target traffic profile? steady qps or spikes?
Maria (CS): Primary workload is chat completions + embeddings for search. Expect spiky daytime traffic, ~1200 concurrent users at peak. Baseline tokens/sec ~45k, bursts to ~120k.
Alex S.: For that, we should start with reserved_quota = 8 GPUs, autoscale min=2 max=24, burst_pool=6. Keeps headroom and fast warmups.
Jin M.: Agree on min/max. Also recommend pre-warming KV cache for top-30 prefixes and enable prefix-caching TTL=6h to avoid cold L2 misses during cutover.
Priya (SE): Can you spell out the load test plan? I need to schedule ops and customer side.
Maria (CS): Plan: 30m smoke, then 2x 10m ramp tests: 60% and 100% peak. Follow with 15m soak at 70%. Goal: verify latency p95 < 350ms and no OOMs.
Sam O.: I'll reserve a maintenance window 2025-06-05 11:00-12:00 UTC. Ops to unblock GPUs and watch memory. @deploy-bot can you create an incident channel?
deploy-bot: Created channel #inc-1746204321-brightline-loadtest :construction:
Alex S.: Autoscale policy draft: scale_up_threshold=75% GPU util sustained 30s, scale_down_threshold=30% sustained 120s, scale_step=+2 instances. Canary rollout weight=5% for 10m before 50%.
Jin M.: Also set fallback model: model_small-v1 as a graceful degrade if latency or error rate spikes >3% for 2 mins. Add alert to Pulse for error-rate and token-cost anomalies.
Priya (SE): I'll collect success criteria from Brightline PM: availability target, max expected token spend, and escalation contacts.
Maria (CS): Capture enablement checklist too: API keys rotated, KMS ok, network egress rules validated, SSO mapping done.
Sam O.: Ops checklist snippet for loadgen:
```
./loadgen --target 120k --ramp 600 --duration 600 --model redwood-4x --kv-priming seeds.json
```
Alex S.: Perf note: use batch_window_ms=12 and max_batch_tokens=2048 to balance throughput/latency for chat.
Priya (SE): I'll run a dry smoke tomorrow 09:00 UTC from our sandbox and share traces.
Maria (CS): Important: renewal ask — flagged risk if we don't meet p95 SLA for first 7 days. Capture that in the post-test summary and action items.
Sam O.: I'll set a temporary quota guard: throttle at 130% of committed to avoid overspend during ramp.
Jin M.: I'll upload a short prompt set for quality checks post-load. We should capture any hallucination regressions tied to quantization or fallback.
Maria (CS): Perfect. Who will own the post-mortem?
Alex S.: I'll own the post-test report + recommended tuning; Priya will append enablement notes.
Maria (CS): Great. Final asks before I ping Brightline: confirm KMS ok (yes/no), confirm maintenance window (Sam), confirm load script ready (Priya), confirm telemetry hooks (Jin).
Priya (SE): KMS checked ✅
Sam O.: Window confirmed ✅
Jin M.: Telemetry hooks in place, sending trace link after smoke.
Maria (CS): Awesome. I'll message Brightline and add folks to #inc-1746204321-brightline-loadtest. Thanks :thumbsup:
Priya (SE): :thumbsup:
Alex S.: :rocket:
